source.test: Pack-managed guard section -- new-policy mutation matrix

expected.reason: Updating one pack-managed add-on to a newer Modrinth build individually is refused -- this is the exact concern the MSC 1 UI's confirmation-dialog wording already gestures at (AddonUpdateSheet.swift's showPackManagedAlert: "Updating individual mods may break the pack's tested version set") without ever actually preventing it. Phase 8 turns that warning into a real refusal.
